shots.text: Under Pearlhaven we brought down the Tidal Leviathan, an eel of grey ice as long as the harbour. It broke apart, and Thalassa rose out of the water.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: The ice-eel collapsing; drowned bronze bells rising out of the water and ringing. Thalassa rising from the sea, sea-glass and current, the bells floating in her hair.

shots.text: I remember every ship that ever sailed this sea, and every child on it. I will remember what you did here.
shots.speaker: thalassa
shots.art_note: Thalassa looking down at the towers and heroes.

shots.text:
The fire went out on the ice, and the sea froze over again. That night Mirelle looked into the ice for a long time. She said she had seen a death at the very end of the war.

She would not say whose.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Mirelle alone on the shore with the ice staff, her blind eyes glowing, reflections in the ice of something we cannot make out. Behind her, Pearlhaven's harbour freezing over.
